notes.title: Steam Next Fest is over & Roadmap check!
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest is over, thank you all!
 The festival has come to an end, and the results for Out of the Shadows are incredibly positive. Your feedback and enthusiasm are a huge motivation as we move forward with development.


Some key numbers
 🕹️ Demo downloads: 4,068 👥 Unique players who launched the game: 2,230


Player breakdown:
20% from Asia

13% from the US

10% from France

Over 35% from Europe overall


What we’ve learned
 Next Fest was a real success for us. Community feedback helped us identify two major areas for improvement:

Accessibility

Clearer & more clues

In-game help systems to assist with puzzle solving

Horror & Atmosphere

Stronger emphasis on immersion and tension in upcoming levels


Roadmap
 🗓️ Late June: Start of internal playtests to finalize Map 1 🛠️ July: Development of Map 2 begins 🚀 Full release planned: Q4 2025



Thanks again for all your support!

notes.title: We're taking part in the Steam Next fest!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that we're part of Steam Next Fest!


Jump into our multiplayer demo, now live on Steam, play solo or team up with up to 4 players!



Don’t miss your chance to experience the game early. 

Check it out and let us know what you think!



We have so much more in stock for the full release ! A couple of maps, more dynamic & unique gameplay features, asymmetric gameplay as well..! 



If you have an idea or want to share feedback, please reach out on our socials, we will be glad to hear from you !
